goal: Propagate Veil ontology and pyramid interface clarification
body: 🧬 Canon update from Dave, 2026-09-05. Hard lock captured as shard 22747@db9: the Veil is living, breathing physical dark-matter substrata. It is primordial, not man-made, not artificial technology, not merely a machine, and not fully an organism. Devices, pyramids, weapons, portals, and interfaces may couple to or shape the Veil but are never the Veil itself. Also captured canon candidate 22494@db1: recovered recursive-history synthesis where Giza and Olympus pyramid systems act as resonators/gates/interfaces to the living Veil substrate, with older canon already tying Egyptian pyramids to the 43,200 Veil harmonic constant and Olympus construction to buried ancient architecture. Exact Earth↔Mars portal mechanics and Great Earth Exodus date remain to be recovered before hard lock. Preserve distinction between Veil ontology and built interface.
resolution: Captured as shard 23439@db6. Veil ontology and pyramid interface clarification acknowledged.
